name: Blaise
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: was an otherwise obscure Arthurian figure

text: Blaise is a figure in Arthurian legend, though not a hero in the usual sense. He is an obscure man. People remember him for one deed. Blaise taught magic to the great wizard Merlin. His own fame rests on the strength of that pupil.

okr.objective: Show Blaise as the obscure Arthurian teacher of Merlin.
key_results: He taught magic to the great Merlin.
Beyond that deed, he remains an obscure figure.
